en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a tree‑lined street leading to a gated entrance of a historic building complex. Behind the wrought‑iron gate and stone wall rises a multi‑storey structure with steep tiled roofs and a prominent central tower topped by a lantern and dome. The scene is framed by large trees on both sides, and handwritten-style text is printed at the bottom right of the image.
